items.title: Defeated candidate Flávio Bolsonaro defies Brazil travel ban with flight to US, sources say
items.brief: Brazilian senator Flávio Bolsonaro has left Brazil and is headed to the United States after losing Sunday’s presidential election, two sources have confirmed to CNN.

items.title: Melania Trump says ceasefire has expanded as it takes effect around Russian-occupied city of Oleshky
items.brief: A localized ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine around the occupied city of Oleshky that first lady Melania Trump helped to broker has now gone into effect, officials on both sides said Tuesday.

items.title: Serial killer Ted Bundy is linked to another Utah teenager’s 1974 murder through DNA testing
items.brief: DNA connects serial killer Ted Bundy to the death of a Utah teenager, authorities announced Tuesday, more than 50 years after her body was discovered by a hunter.

items.title: King Charles heads to Caribbean as calls grow for slavery apology
items.brief: Britain’s King Charles III will begin a tour of the Caribbean on Tuesday as pressure mounts on Britain to apologize and pay reparations for its role in the slave trade.

items.title: Manhunt underway for convicted killer who escaped through Tennessee prison fence and fled in stolen truck, officials say
items.brief: Tennessee authorities are searching for a 28-year-old convicted murderer who escaped through a state prison’s fence late Sunday night before stealing a truck and driving off.
